تتصاعدي (form VI)
# تَتَصَاعَدِي (tataṣāʕadī) /ta.ta.sˤaː.ʕa.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَصَاعَدَ (taṣāʕada)
# تُتَصَاعَدِي (tutaṣāʕadī) /tu.ta.sˤaː.ʕa.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَصَاعَدَ (taṣāʕada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
